description: KYC and AML compliance for regulated businesses. Open a KYC case for an individual or company and send your client a link to complete the KYC form and upload supporting documents. Each submission is screened against World-Check, and your compliance team resolves matches, assesses risk and signs off the case in VeriKYC. Requires a VeriKYC account.
